title: Surface-pressure surrogate benchmark over a parametric car family
description: Geometry point cloud in, surface kinematic pressure out, over a parametric car family (three roof lines, open/closed wheel arches); labels from the library's lattice-Boltzmann tunnel; six surrogate families ranked with per-geometry relative L2, bootstrap intervals and the paired significance test.

metrics.name: geometries_labelled
metrics.how: lattice-Boltzmann, 40 cells per car length, 6000 steps, Re 300

metrics.name: label_max_density_deviation
metrics.how: largest density excursion of the lattice over the campaign: how far the label is from the incompressible limit

metrics.name: label_cd_mean
metrics.how: mean over the labelled designs, coarse lattice, front area of every design

metrics.name: wall_faces_per_geometry
metrics.how: wall faces of the voxelized body, = input points of the surrogate

metrics.name: categories
metrics.how: estateback/closed, estateback/open, fastback/closed, fastback/open, notchback/closed, notchback/open

metrics.name: best_rel_l2
metrics.how: crash_solver, mean over 3 held-out geometries, 95% CI (0.9759488135792935, 0.9759488135792935)

metrics.name: best_r2
metrics.how: crash_solver, pooled over all test points

metrics.name: pair_gap
metrics.how: crash_solver minus transolver_lite, paired bootstrap, win rate 1.00, p_perm 0.247

metrics.name: subsampled_rel_l2
metrics.how: crash_solver scored on every second wall face only
